 By BVM Sportsdesk, 11/13/2026 Unbeaten DePaul takes its 4-0 start on the road Saturday to face No. 13/11 Notre Dame in the Shamrock Classic in White Sulphur Springs, West Virginia. The Blue Demons bring a high-scoring, balanced offense; Notre Dame enters 3-0 after three decisive wins.
 By the Numbers DePaul is 4-0, its best start since 2016-17, and has won by an average of 25.5 points.
 DePaul averages 89.3 points per game; Notre Dame averages 110.0.
 Notre Dame leads the all-time series 27-20; the teams are tied 2-2 at neutral sites.
 Yes, But DePaul’s strong start faces a formidable test: Notre Dame leads Division I in field-goal percentage and is powered by senior All-American Hannah Hidalgo, averaging 27.3 points per game.
 State of Play Tipoff is Saturday, Nov. 14, at noon CT; the game will air on NBC and Peacock.
 DePaul averages 26.0 assists per game, second nationally, and has five players scoring in double figures.
 Notre Dame is 3-0, averaging 110 points per game, with six players averaging double figures.
 What's Next DePaul returns home Wednesday, Nov. 18, to host Bradley at 6 p.m. CT at Wintrust Arena; the game will stream on ESPN+.
 Bottom Line Saturday is an early measuring-stick matchup: DePaul’s unbeaten start and team-oriented offense will be tested by one of the nation’s most explosive teams.
